title: Microsoft 365 admin center: rules that automate agent lifecycle management
summary: The briefing's control paths, Graph block call and licensing statements are supported by Microsoft's documentation. It accurately distinguishes the roadmap's deletion and risky-agent scenarios from the narrower rules described on the Agent settings page.

claims.claim: Eligible registry agents have a manual Install action.
claims.quote: From the list of agents, select an agent that isn't already installed. ... immediately under the agent's name, select **Install**.

claims.claim: Eligible registry agents have a manual Uninstall action.
claims.quote: In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select **Uninstall**. ... If you don't see the Uninstall option, the selected agent might not be installed.

claims.claim: Agent details provides a Pin for users action.
claims.quote: you can also select specific actions for the agent, such as **Install**, **Block**, **Uninstall**, and **Pin for users**.

claims.claim: Pinning requires an agent already deployed to some or all users.
claims.quote: You can only pin agents that are deployed to some or all users.

claims.claim: All agents includes an Agents without owners card for finding ownerless agents.
claims.quote: When you select the **Agents without owners** card, the agent list is filtered to show the agents based on **Publisher type** and **Owner**.

claims.claim: Blocking Agent Builder or Copilot Studio agents affects their availability in Copilot.
claims.quote: Blocking or unblocking an agent that you created by using Microsoft Copilot Agent Builder and Microsoft Copilot Studio affects its availability and functionality in Microsoft Copilot.

claims.claim: Blocking Agent Builder or Copilot Studio agents also affects host apps such as Teams and Outlook.
claims.quote: It also affects availability and functionality in other host products, such as Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Teams, or other Microsoft 365 applications.

claims.claim: Blocking SharePoint or Foundry agents affects only their availability in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: However, blocking an agent that you created by using SharePoint or Microsoft Foundry only impacts its availability in Microsoft Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: Researcher and Analyst can be blocked for the entire tenant.
claims.quote: To manage their availability, block the agent for the entire tenant by using the **Block** action in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Researcher and Analyst availability cannot be scoped with Edit users.
claims.quote: For the Researcher and Analyst agents, the **Edit users** panel is disabled.

claims.claim: The Agent settings page also carries security-template controls.
claims.quote: **Security templates** - Create preset policies, rules, and allow lists for new AI agents to ensure consistency and compliance.

claims.claim: Agent and plugin access settings distinguish Microsoft, organisational and external publishers.
claims.quote: **Allow agents and plugins built by Microsoft** ... **Allow agents and plugins built by your organization** ... **Allow agents and plugins built by external publishers**

claims.claim: The Agent settings page carries sharing controls.
claims.quote: **Sharing** - Manage who can share AI agents within your organization and define the methods they can use to share them.

claims.claim: The Agent settings page carries tag-management controls.
claims.quote: **Tags** - Manage the labels that admins and users apply to agents to organize and find them.

claims.claim: Agents can become ownerless when their original creator leaves the organisation.
claims.quote: Agents become ownerless when their original creator leaves the organization. Administrators must currently identify and transfer ownership manually, which can result in lifecycle governance gaps.

### Prerequisites for viewing risk signals

- Your tenant must have an E7 or A365 license.

claims.claim: The registry consolidates agent risk signals from platforms such as Purview, Entra and Defender.
claims.quote: Risk signals are sourced from: Displays the Microsoft security platforms contributing risk signals for the agent, such as Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra, and Microsoft Defender.

claims.claim: Reassignment gives the new manager ownership rights over the agent.
claims.quote: The following changes occur after owner reassignment: ... The new owner gets full edit and delete permissions, plus access to any files the previous owner uploaded.

claims.claim: Deleting an agent in the Microsoft 365 admin center soft deletes it.
claims.quote: When you delete an agent in the Microsoft 365 admin center, the agent is soft deleted.

claims.claim: Admin-center agent deletion has a 30-day recovery window.
claims.quote: You can restore an agent only while it's soft deleted and within its 30-day retention period.

claims.claim: Permanent agent deletion cannot be undone.
claims.quote: Permanently deleting an agent removes the agent and its associated resources and can't be undone.
